SELECT
FROM payment p
INNER JOIN member buyer ON p.member_id = buyer.id
INNER JOIN subscription s ON p.subscription_id = s.id
INNER JOIN member seller ON s.creator_id = seller.id
AND ( buyer.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR buyer.unique_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND p.status = #{paymentStatus}
AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate}
AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM payment p

AND p.status = #{paymentStatus}
AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate}
